7.3.2.8.11 Service 0x29 – Authentication
The UDS service Authentication (0x29) is used by the ECU as a means to identify the
client and provide the relevant access to diagnostic resources, based on the client’s
’role’. The access to these diagnostic resources can be limited in time, or, bound
to certain vehicles or ECUs. The specifications of this chapter are based on the UDS
Specifications ISO 14229-1:2020 [1]. The specifications of this chapter are a sub-set of
the service 0x29 specifications of ISO 14229-1:2020 [1], and the Diagnostic Manager
may only implement the specifications of this chapter.
